note: The frog's colours. Read by design/frog/tools/color_guardian.py: every frog asset is checked against this before it ships and repainted if it drifted. A new prop (a sake bottle, a flame) goes into 'extras'; a new look on purpose (a new skin, the sensei) is a new entry under 'skins'. Change a value here only with Marek's OK: this is the brand. Skins llama/platypus/monkey/corgi: the laptop gang's outfits (one colour each, in shades), measured off Marek's picks; the frog's own check does not cover them yet.
